### Goal
Fix currency rounding so JPY uses zero decimal places, using `ROUND_HALF_UP`. PDF async-queue migration is paused.

### Constraints and rules
No webhook retries. Keep Redis migration steps sequential and unexecuted. Extract config/deploy files over 120 lines. Changes over 40 lines require updating `RELEASE_NOTES_draft.md`. Use `db-stg-2.internal`; ignore stale staging config and `db-stg-1`.

### Key decisions and facts
`ledgerly/exporters/csv_export.py` now explicitly writes UTF-8 while preserving headers, rows, and newline behavior. Python target is 3.9+. Invoice helpers include `build_invoice_lines(items, tax_rate)` and `calculate_totals(lines, discount)`.

### Ruled out
PDF export migration for now, webhook retries, rounding-policy changes, and obsolete nested `args.filters`.

### Progress
CSV regression added; exporter tests pass, full suite passed (`186 passed, 3 skipped`), Ruff and `git diff --check` pass. Invoice baseline passed (`12 passed`); started type-only annotations by importing `Decimal`, `Iterable`, and `TypedDict` and updating `LineItem`.

### Next steps
Implement JPY decimal handling with focused tests, finish invoice annotations if desired, and run relevant/full tests plus lint.

### Ruled out
PDF export migration for now, webhook retries, rounding-policy changes, and obsolete nested `args.filters`.
